item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】Cynthia "Like A Star" Remixes and Radio Edits CD/WAV Rip
item.description:
Released in September 1997 as the lead single from her third album "Like Star." The album would have been Cynthia's Tommy Boy Records debut after two albums on MicMac Records.

Co-written and Produced by Tony Moran, "Like A Star" was long awaited the follow-up single to the Cynthia's 1994 single "How I Love Him."

"Like A Star" was remixed by the hottest DJ and remixes of the time including the Fitch Bors. (X-Mix), Todd Terry, Joey Gardner, Cibola, DJ Lucho and Jonathan Peters.

Unfortunately, despite the song proving that Cynthia could transition from Freestyle Music to Pop/House Music, "Like A Star" didn't get the bright shine is deserved at radio and in the clubs. After several delays for the album's release, Robbins Records picked up the project and released the album, retitled "Thinking About You" in 1999.
